paragraphs.en: the /ŋ/ nasal sound (sing, think, ring)
paragraphs.zh: 在英语中，/ŋ/是一个鼻音，发音时舌尖抵住上齿龈，软腭上升，让气流从鼻腔通过。这个音在单词如'sing', 'think', 'ring'中出现。与汉语中的鼻音相比，英语的/ŋ/发音更为明显，且通常出现在单词的末尾。

paragraphs.en: sing /sɪŋ/  |  think /θɪŋk/  |  ring /rɪŋ/  |  long /lɒŋ/  |  song /sɒŋ/
paragraphs.zh:
sing /sɪŋ/ — 唱歌
think /θɪŋk/ — 思考
ring /rɪŋ/ — 铃声
long /lɒŋ/ — 长
song /sɒŋ/ — 歌曲

paragraphs.en: I can't sing a single note.
paragraphs.zh: 我唱不出一个音符。

paragraphs.en: Think about what you want to do next.
paragraphs.zh: 想想你接下来想做什么。

paragraphs.en: The bell rings at 7 o'clock.
paragraphs.zh: 铃在七点钟响。

paragraphs.en: This book is very long.
paragraphs.zh: 这本书非常长。

paragraphs.en: She is singing a beautiful song.
paragraphs.zh: 她正在唱一首美丽的歌曲。

extraData.tips: 为了更好地掌握/ŋ/的发音，可以多听英语原声材料，模仿发音。同时，可以通过练习舌尖抵住上齿龈的动作来加强发音的准确性。

Excuse me, Professor Williams. Do you have a moment? I wanted to ask about your Introduction to Environmental Science course.
Sure, come in. What would you like to know?
Well, I'm a second-year biology major, and I'm interested in taking your course next semester. But I noticed it says "limited enrollment" on the registration page.
Yes, that's right. We cap it at thirty-five students because of the lab component. Each student needs hands-on access to the lab equipment.
I see. Is there still space available?
As of this morning, there were three spots left. But I'd recommend registering as soon as possible. It usually fills up within the first week of registration.
Got it. I also wanted to ask — I see there's a field trip listed on the syllabus. Is that mandatory?
The field trip to the wetlands research station? Yes, it's a required part of the course. We spend a full Saturday there collecting water samples and observing the local ecosystem. It counts for fifteen percent of your final grade.
That sounds really interesting. One more thing — does this course count toward the environmental studies minor?
Absolutely. It's actually one of the core requirements for that minor.

articles.title: CET-6 Listening - Lecture: The Psychology of Decision-Making
articles.titleZh: 六级听力 — 讲座：决策心理学

paragraphs.en: Decision fatigue: the quality of our decisions deteriorates after making many decisions in a row.
paragraphs.zh: 决策疲劳：连续做很多决策后，我们的决策质量会下降。

paragraphs.en: Judges tend to make more favorable rulings in the morning. Prisoners had a 65% chance of parole at the start of the day, dropping to nearly zero before a break.
paragraphs.zh: 法官倾向于在上午做出更有利的裁决。囚犯在一天开始时有65%的假释机会，在休息前降到接近零。

paragraphs.en: Solutions: Make important decisions early. Simplify routine decisions — like wearing the same outfit every day.
paragraphs.zh: 解决方案：重要决策放在早上做。简化日常决策——比如每天穿同样的衣服。

questions.question: What is 'decision fatigue'?
options: Decision quality drops after many decisions
questions.explanation: 原文定义：the quality of our decisions deteriorates after making many decisions in a row

questions.question: What was the parole rate at the start of the day?
questions.explanation: 原文: a 65% chance of being granted parole at the start of the day

questions.question: Why do some CEOs wear the same outfit every day?
options: To save mental energy for important decisions
questions.explanation: 原文: They're saving their mental energy for decisions that truly matter

extraData.audioText:
Today I'd like to discuss an interesting phenomenon in psychology known as "decision fatigue." Research has shown that the quality of our decisions deteriorates after making many decisions in a row. This is why judges, for example, tend to make more favorable rulings in the morning than in the afternoon.

A famous study examined over a thousand judicial decisions and found that prisoners had a 65% chance of being granted parole at the start of the day, but that dropped to nearly zero just before a break. After the judges had a meal and rested, the rate jumped back up to 65%.

So what can we do about this? First, make your most important decisions early in the day when your mental energy is highest. Second, simplify routine decisions — this is why some successful CEOs wear the same outfit every day. They're saving their mental energy for decisions that truly matter.

articles.title: Graduate Entrance Exam - Passage: AI in Healthcare
articles.titleZh: 考研英语听力 — 人工智能在医疗中的应用

paragraphs.en: AI is transforming healthcare, especially in medical imaging analysis, matching or exceeding radiologists' accuracy.
paragraphs.zh: AI 正在改变医疗行业，尤其是在医学影像分析方面，准确率可以匹配甚至超过放射科医生。

paragraphs.en: An AI system identified breast cancer with 11.5% fewer false negatives than human doctors.
paragraphs.zh: 一个 AI 系统识别乳腺癌时，假阴性率比人类医生低11.5%。

paragraphs.en: Experts say AI should assist doctors, not replace them — creating 'augmented intelligence.'
paragraphs.zh: 专家认为 AI 应该辅助医生而非取代他们——创造"增强智能"。

paragraphs.en: Challenges: diverse training datasets to avoid bias, regulations for privacy and data security.
paragraphs.zh: 挑战：多样化训练数据以避免偏见，以及隐私和数据安全法规。

questions.question: What is one of the most promising AI applications in healthcare?
questions.explanation: 原文: One of the most promising applications is in medical imaging analysis

questions.question: By how much did the AI reduce false negatives in breast cancer detection?
What term do researchers use for AI combined with human judgment?
questions.explanation: 原文: creating what researchers call 'augmented intelligence'

questions.question: What challenge is mentioned for AI in healthcare?
questions.explanation: 原文: ensuring that these systems are trained on diverse datasets to avoid bias

extraData.audioText:
Artificial intelligence is rapidly transforming the healthcare industry. One of the most promising applications is in medical imaging analysis. AI algorithms can now detect certain types of cancer in medical scans with accuracy rates that match or even exceed those of experienced radiologists.

For instance, a study published in Nature Medicine demonstrated that an AI system could identify breast cancer in mammograms with 11.5% fewer false negatives than human doctors. This means fewer cases of cancer being missed during routine screenings.

However, experts caution that AI should be viewed as a tool to assist doctors rather than replace them. The technology works best when combined with human judgment, creating what researchers call "augmented intelligence." A doctor might use AI to flag potential issues in hundreds of scans, then apply their clinical experience to make the final diagnosis.

The challenge going forward is ensuring that these systems are trained on diverse datasets to avoid bias, and that proper regulations are in place to protect patient privacy and data security.

articles.title: Diphthongs /aɪ/ /eɪ/ /ɔɪ/
articles.titleZh: 英语双元音 /aɪ/ /eɪ/ /ɔɪ/ 发音教学

paragraphs.en: English diphthongs: /aɪ/ (my, time), /eɪ/ (day, make), /ɔɪ/ (boy, toy)
paragraphs.zh: 双元音是由两个元音组成的音，发音时舌尖放在上下齿之间，口腔从第一个元音的位置滑向第二个元音的位置。例如，/aɪ/ 发音时，先发 /a/ 的音，然后舌尖快速移动到 /ɪ/ 的位置。/eɪ/ 和 /ɔɪ/ 的发音方式类似，但元音的位置和移动方向有所不同。

paragraphs.en: my /maɪ/  |  time /taɪm/  |  day /deɪ/  |  make /meɪk/  |  boy /baɪ/  |  toy /taɪ/
paragraphs.zh:
my /maɪ/ — 我的
time /taɪm/ — 时间
day /deɪ/ — 一天
make /meɪk/ — 制作
boy /baɪ/ — 男孩
toy /taɪ/ — 玩具

paragraphs.en: I have a red bike.
paragraphs.zh: 我有一辆红色的自行车。

extraData.explanation: 双元音是由两个元音组成的音，发音时舌尖放在上下齿之间，口腔从第一个元音的位置滑向第二个元音的位置。例如，/aɪ/ 发音时，先发 /a/ 的音，然后舌尖快速移动到 /ɪ/ 的位置。/eɪ/ 和 /ɔɪ/ 的发音方式类似，但元音的位置和移动方向有所不同。

The cat is sleeping on the mat.
He will go to the park today.

extraData.commonMistakes: 1. 拖音过重，将双元音读成单音；2. 发音时舌尖位置不准确，导致发音不准确；3. 两个元音的转换不够流畅。
extraData.tips: 1. 多听多模仿，注意双元音的转换过程；2. 练习时可以尝试用镜子观察舌尖的位置变化；3. 多练习相关的单词和句子，提高发音的准确性。

paragraphs.en: assimilation: sounds changing to match neighboring sounds (e.g., "ten people" → "tem people", "good boy" → "goob boy")
paragraphs.zh: 同化是指在发音时，一个音素会根据邻近的音素发生改变，以匹配其发音。例如，在英语中，'ten people' 中的 'ten' 发音为 'tem'，'good boy' 中的 'good' 发音为 'goob'，这是因为 'n' 和 'd' 分别与 'p' 和 'b' 发生同化。

paragraphs.en: He has a pen and a pencil.

extraData.explanation: 同化是指在发音时，一个音素会根据邻近的音素发生改变，以匹配其发音。例如，在英语中，'ten people' 中的 'ten' 发音为 'tem'，'good boy' 中的 'good' 发音为 'goob'，这是因为 'n' 和 'd' 分别与 'p' 和 'b' 发生同化。

practiceSentences.en: Please take a seat.
She is a good girl.
He has a pen and a pencil.
practiceSentences.zh: 他有一支钢笔和一支铅笔。

extraData.commonMistakes: 一些中国学习者可能会错误地将同化的音素发成其原本的音，例如将 'pen' 发音为 'pen' 而不是 'peny'，或者将 'good' 发音为 'good' 而不是 'goob'。
extraData.tips: 为了提高同化现象的发音准确性，可以多听英语原声材料，注意观察并模仿同化音素的发音。同时，可以通过练习以下句子来加强发音：'ten people', 'good boy', 'stop the car', 'sit down'.
